G4700.def:
σποδός, -oῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for אֵפֶר ;]
ashes: Hb 9:13; ἐν σάκκῳ καὶ σ. (Is 58:5, Jo 3:6, Dan LXX 9:3, al.), Mt 11:21, Lc 10:13.†
(AS)

G4701.def:
σπορά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(σπείρω), [in LXX: 4Ki.19:29 (זָרַע), 1Ma.10:30 * ;]
__1. a sowing.
__2. seedtime.
__3. seed sown (of human offspring, Soph., Tr., 316, 420): 1Pe 1:23
(cf. σπέρμα, and see Milligan, NTD, 105 f.).†
(AS)

G4702.def:
σπόριμος, -ον
(σπείρω) [in LXX: Gn 1:29, Lv 11:37 (זָרַע), Sir 40:22 א1 * ;]
fit for sowing, sown; as subst., τὰ σ., corn-fields: Mt 12:1, Mc 2:23, Lc 6:1.†
(AS)

G4703.def:
σπόρος, -ου, ὁ
(σπείρω), [in LXX chiefly for זֶרַע ;]
= σπορά,
__1. sowing or seedtime.
__2. seed sown (so usually in late Gk.): Mc 4:26-27, Lc 8:5, 11, 2Co 9:10 a (LTr.); metaphorically, of almsgiving, 2Co 9:10 b.†
(AS)

G4704.def:
σπουδάζω
(σπουδή), [in LXX chiefly for בָּהַל ;]
to make haste; hence, to be zealous or eager, to give diligence: with inf. (see M, Pr., 205 f.), Gl 2:10, Ef 4:3, 1Ts 2:17, 2Tm 2:15 4:9 4:21, Tt 3:12, Hb 4:11, 2Pe 1:10 3:14; with accusative and inf. (on this construction see Mayor in l; MM, xxiii), 2Pe 1:15 (for other constructions see LS, see word).†
(AS)

G4705.def:
σπουδαῖος, -α, -ον
(σπουδή), [in LXX: Eze.41:25 * ;]
in haste; hence, zealous, eager, diligent, earnest: before ἐν, 2Co 8:22; compar., -οτεροσς 2Co 8:17 (here in superl. sense, see Bl., § 44, 3) 2Co 8:22.†
(AS)

G4708.def:
earnestly, zealously, with vigor; (compar.) all the more eager, with special urgency eagerly
earnestly, eagerly, diligently, Lk. 7:4; 2Tim. 1:17; Tit. 3:13; comparative σπουδαιοτέρως, more earnestly, with special urgency, Phil. 2:28

G4709.def:
σπουδαίως
adv. (σπουδαῖος), [in LXX: Wis.2:6 * ;]
__1. with haste or zeal, i.e. earnestly, zealously, diligently: Lc 7:4, 2Tm 1:17, Tt 3:13; compar., -οτέρως, Fp 2:28 (RV, Lft., Weymouth, al., but see infr.)
__2. hastily, speedily: compar., -οτέρως, Fp 2:28 (Thayer, Zorell, see word; ICC, in l, al., but see supr.).†
(AS)

G4710.def:
σπουδή, -ῆς, ἡ
(σπεύδω), [in LXX chiefly for בָּהַל, its parts and derivatives ;]
__1. haste, speed: μετὰ σ. (Wis.19:2), Mc 6:25, Lc 1:39.
__2. zeal, diligence, earnestness: Rm 12:11, 2Co 7:11-12 8:7-8; ἐν σ., Rm 12:8 (see M, Pr, 104); before ὑπέρ, 2Co 8:16; σπουδὴν ἐνδείκνυσθαι, Hb 6:11; σ. παρεισφέρειν, 2Pe 1:5; πᾶσαν σ. ποιεῖσθαι, Ju 3 (see MM, xxiii; M, Pr., 214; Deiss., BS, 361, 364).†
(AS)

G4711.def:
σφυρίς (T, Rec. σπυρίς, see WH, App., 148; 131., § 6, 7), -ίδος, ἡ,
a flexible mat-basket for carrying provisions: Mt 15:37 16:10, Mc 8:8, 20 At 9:25 (see: κόφινος).†
(AS)

G4712.def:
στάδιον, -ου, τό pl., στάδια (Jo 6:19, T), and metapl., στάδιοι (see B1., 9, 1),
[in LXX: Dan LXX 4:9, Sus 1:37, 2Ma.11:5 2Mac 12:9 ff. * ;]
a stadium, i.e.
__1. a measure of length = 600 Greek feet or 1⁄8 of a Roman mile Mt 14:24 (Rec., WH, txt., R, mg.), Lc 24:13, Jo 6:19 11:18, Ap 14:20 21:16, and, this being the length of the Olympic course,
__2. a race-course: 1Co 9:24.†
(AS)

G4713.def:
στάρνος, -ου (ὁ and), ἡ
[in LXX: Êx 16:33 (צִנְצֶנֶת), 3Ki.12:24 14:3 (בַּקְבֻּק), Dan LXX Bel, 1:32 * ;]
prop., an earthen jar for racking off wine, hence, generally, a jar: Hb 9:4.†
(AS)

G4714.def:
στάσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἵστημι), [in LXX chiefly for עָמַד, its parts and derivatives, also for רִיב (Pr 1714), etc. (see Deiss., BS, 158 f.) ;]
__1. a standing, place, status: σ. ἔχειν (Polyb., v, 5, 3; and cf. Lat. locum habere), Hb 9:8.
__2. insurrection, sedition: Mc 15:7, Lc 23:19, 25, At 19:40 24:5.
__3. In poets and late prose, strife, dissension (cf. MM, xxiii) At 15:2 23:7, 10.†
(AS)

G4715.def:
στατήρ, -ῆρος, ὁ
[in Aq., Sm., for מִשְׁקָל ;]
a stater;
__(a) a weight;
__(b) a coin (used by late writers of the Greek τετράδραχμον): Mt 17:27 26:16, WH, mg.†
(AS)

G4716.def:
σταυρός, -oῦ, ὁ
__1. an upright pale or stake (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.)
__2. In late writers (Diod., Plut., al.) of the Roman instrument of crucifixion, the Cross: of the Cross on which Christ suffered, Mt 27:32, 40 27:42, Mc 15:21, 30 15:32, Lc 23:26, Jo 19:17, 19 19:25, 31, Cl 2:14, Hb 12:2; θάνατος σταυροῦ, Fp 2:8; τ. αἷμα τοῦ σ., Cl 1:20. Metaphorical, in proverbial sayings: αἴρειν (λαμβάνειν, βαστάζειν) τὸν σ., Mt 10:38 16:24, Mc 8:34 10:21, 15:21, Lc 9:23 14:27 (for an interesting ex. of metaphorically use in π., see MM, xxiii) By meton., for Christ's death on the Cross: 1Co 1:17, Gl 5:11 6:12, 14, Ef 2:16, Fp 3:18; ὁ λόγος ὁ τοῦ σ., 1Co 1:18.†
(AS)

G4717.def:
σταυρόω, -ῶ
(σταυρός), [in LXX: Et 7:9 (תָּלָה), Et 8:13 * ;]
__1. to fence with pales, impalisade (Thuc.).
__2. In late writers (Polyb., FlJ; but ἀνασταυρόω is more common) to crucify: with accusative of person(s), Mt 20:19 23:34 26:2 27:22 ff. Mt 28:5, Mc 15:16 ff. Mc 16:6, Lc 23:21, 23 23:33 24:7, 20, Jo 19:6 ff., At 2:36 4:10, 1Co 1:13 1:23 2:2 2:8, 2Co 13:4, Gl 3:1, Ap 11:8; metaphorically, Gl 5:24 6:14.†
(AS)

G4718.def:
σταφυλή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX for עֵנָב ;]
a bunch of grapes: Mt 7:16, Lc 6:44, Ap 14:18. "σ. is properly the ripe grape-cluster as opposite to ὄμφαξ, cf. Gn 40:10, Jó 15:33; as contrasted with βότρυς, it describes the grapes rather than the cluster on which they grow" (Swete, Apoc., 187 f.).†
(AS)

G4719.def:
στάχυς, -υος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for שִׁבֹּל ;]
an ear of corn: Mt 12:1, Mc 2:23 4:28, Lc 6:1.†
(AS)

G4720.def:
Στάχυς, -υος, ὁ
Stachys: Rm 16:9 (see Lft., Phi., 174; MM, xxiii).†
(AS)

G4721.def:
στέγη, -ης, ἡ
(στέγω) [in LXX: Gn 8:13 (מְכַסֶּה), etc. ;]
a roof: Mc 2:4; of entering a house, εἰσέρχεσθαι ὑπὸ τὴν σ., Mt 8:8, Lc 7:6 (cf. MM, xxiii).†
(AS)

G4722.def:
στέγω
(cf. Lat. tego), [in LXX: Sir.8:17 * ;]
__1. prop., to cover closely, to protect by covering, esp. to keep water in or out (Soph., Plat., al.).
__2. to cover, keep secret, conceal (Sir, l.with, Polyb., al.): 1Co 13:7, R, mg.
__3. By covering to ward of, bear up under, endure (for exx., see, Lft., Notes, 40; M, Th., 36): 1Co 9:12 13:7, 1Ts 3:1 3:5.†
(AS)

G4723.def:
στεῖρος, -ον also -α, -ον,
[in LXX for עָקָר ;]
barren: of a woman, Lc 1:7, 36 23:29, Gl 4:27" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G4724.def:
στέλλω
[in LXX (mid.): Ml 2:5 (חָתַת ni.), Pv 31:24 (26), Wis.7:14 14:1, 2Ma.5:1, 3Ma.1:19 3Mac 4:11 * ;]
__1. prop., to set, place, arrange, fit out; hence, mid., to set oneself for, prepare (Wis, xi Mac, ll. with).
__2. to bring together, gather up (in Hom. of furling sails), hence to restrain, check; mid., to restrain or withdraw oneself, hold aloof, avoid: 2Co 8:20; before ἀπό, 2Ts 3:6
(cf. ἀπο-, ἐξ-απο-, συν-απο-, δια-, ἐπι-, κατα-, συ(ν)-, ὑπο-στέλλω).†
(AS)

G4725.def:
στέμμα, -τος, τό
(στέφω, to put around, enwreath)
a wreath, garland: as used in sacrifices, At 14:13.†
(AS)

G4726.def:
στεναγμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(στενάζω), [in LXX for אֲנָחָה, אֲנָקָה, נְאָקָה, etc. ;]
a groaning: At 7:34 (LXX κραυγή), Rm 8:26.†
(AS)

G4727.def:
στενάζω
[in LXX for אָנַח ni., אָנַק, etc. ;]
to groan ("the word denotes feeling which is internal and unexpressed," Mayor, Ja., 162): Mc 7:34, 2Co 5:2 5:4, Hb 13:17, Tg 5:9 (EV, murmur); ἐν ἑαυτοῖς, Rm 8:23 (cf. ἀνα-, συ(ν)-στενάζω).†
SYN.: see: κλαίω (AS)

G4728.def:
στενός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX for צַר, etc. ;]
narrow: fig (v MM, xxiii), Mt 7:13-14, Lc 13:24.†
(AS)

G4729.def:
στενο-χωρέω, -ῶ
(στενός + χῶρος, space) [in LXX: Js 17:15 (אוּץ), Jz 16:16 (אָלַץ pi.), Is 28:19 (20) (קָצַר) Is 49:19 (צָרַר), 4Ma.11:11 * ;]
__1. to be straitened (cf. Is 49:19); metaphorically, to be anxious (Hipp., al.).
__2. In late writers, trans., to straiten, compress (LXX, Diod., al.; π. ap. MM, xxiii): pass., trop., 2Co 4:8 6:12.†
(AS)

G4730.def:
στενοχωρία, -ας, ἡ (see supr.)
[in LXX for צוֹק, etc. ;]
narrowness of space, want of room (Thuc., al.). Metaphorical (Ken., Polyb., Dt 28:53, Wis.5:3, al.), difficulty, distress: θλίψις καὶ (ἢ) σ., Rm 2:9 8:35 (EV, anguish); pl. (cf. Bl., § 32, 6; WM, 220), 2Co 6:4 12:10.†
SYN.: θλίψις, q.v (AS)

G4731.def:
στερεός, -ά, -όν
[in LXX: Nm 8:4 (מִקְשָׁה); σ. πέτρα, Is 5:28 (צַר), etc. ;]
hard, firm, solid: τροψή, Hb 5:12, 14; θεμέλιος, figuratively, 2Tm 2:19. Metaphorical,
__(a) in bad sense, hard, cruel (Hom., al.);
__(b) in good sense, steadfast, firm: τ. πίστει, 1Pe 5:9.†
(AS)

G4732.def:
στερεόω, -ῶ
(στερεός), [in LXX: Is 42:5 (רָקַע), Jr 5:3 (חָזַק pi.), etc. ;]
__(a) to make firm or solid;
__(b) to strengthen, make strong; with accusative of person(s), At 3:16; τ. βάσεις, pass., At 3:7. Metaphorical (cf. Je, l.with): τ. πίστει, pass., At 16:5.†
(AS)

G4733.def:
στερέωμα, -τος, τό
(στερεόω), [in LXX: Gn 1:6 ff., Sl 19:1 150:1, Eze.1:22-26 10:1 13:5, Dan LXX, TH Dn 3:56, Dn 12:3 (רָקִיעַ), Dt 33:26 (שַׁחַק), Sl 18:2 71:3 (סֶלַע), Et 9:29, I Et 8:78 (82), Sir.43:1, 8, 1Ma.9:14 * ;]
a solid body;
__(a) a support, foundation (Arist., al.); metaphorically, strength (Sl 17:1-15 70:1-5, 1Mac, ll. with); steadfastness, firmness: τ. πίστεως, Cl 2:5;
__(b) the dome of heaven (believed to be a solid canopy), the firmament (LXX).†
(AS)

G4735.def:
στέφανος, -ου, ὁ
(στέφω, to encircle), [in LXX chiefly for עֲטָרָה ;]
__1. that which surrounds or encompasses (as a wall, a crowd: Hom., al.).
__2. a crown, i.e. the wreath, garland or chaplet given as a prize for victory, as a festal ornament, or as a public honour for disting­uished service or personal worth (so to sovereigns, especially on the occasion of a παρουσία, which see; cf. Deiss., LAE, 372 ff.; on its use in LXX for the golden crown of royalty (prop., διάδημα, which see, cf. Hort and Mayor on Tg 1:12): Mt 27:29, Mc 15:17, Jo 19:2, 5, 1Co 9:25, Ap 4:4, 10 6:2 9:7 12:1 14:14. Metaphorical: Fp 4:1, Ap 3:11; τ. δικαιοσύνης (cf. Deiss., LAE, 312), 2Tm 4:8; τ. δόξης, 1Pe 5:4; καυχήσεως, 1Ts 2:19 (see M, Th., in l); τ. ζωῆς (genitive appos.), Tg 1:12, Ap 2:10.†
(AS)

G4737.def:
στεφανόω, -ῶ
(στέφανος), [in LXX for עָטַר ;]
with accusative of person(s),
to crown: of a victor, 2Tm 2:5. Metaphorical, δόξῃ κ. τιμῇ, Hb 2:7, 9" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G4738.def:
στῆθος, -ους, τό
[in LXX: Êx 28:23, 26 (29-30) (לֵב), etc. ;]
the breast: Jo 13:25 21:10, Ap 15:6; as a sign of penitence, τύπτειν (εἰς) τὸ σ., Lc 18:13 23:48,†
(AS)

G4739.def:
στήκω late Pres., formed from perf., ἕστηκα (see B1., § 17; WH, App., 169; Kennedy, Sources, 158; M, Pr., 238; MM, xxiii),
[in LXX: Êx 14:13 A, Jz 16:26 B, 3Ki.8:11 B * ;]
= ἵστημι, to stand: Mc 3:31 11:25, Jo 1:26, Ap 12:4 (ἕστηκεν T). Metaphorical, to stand firm, stand fast: absol., Gl 5:1 (but see Field, Notes, 189 f.), 2Ts 2:15; before ἐν, Jo 8:44 (ἕστηκεν, T, R, mg.), 1Co 16:13, Fp 1:27 4:1; with dative, Rm 14:4.†
(AS)

G4740.def:
στηριγμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(στηρίζω), [in Sm.: Is 3:1 * ;]
__1. a setting firmly, supporting.
__2. fixedness, firmness, steadfastness: 2Pe 3:17.†
(AS)

G4741.def:
στηρίζω
[in LXX for סָמַךְ, שׂוּם, etc. ;]
to fix, set fast, make fast: Lc 16:26; τ. πρόσωτον (Eze.6:2 13:17, al.; see Dalman, Words, 30 f.), Lc 9:51. Metaphorical, to confirm, establish: with, accusative, Lc 22:32, At 18:23, Rm 1:11 16:25, 1Ts 3:2 3:13, 2Ts 3:3, Tg 5:8, 1Pe 5:10, Ap 3:2; id. before ἐν, 2Ts 2:17, 2Pe 1:12.†
(AS)

G4742.def:
στίγμα -τος, τό
(στίζω, to prick), [in LXX: Ct 1:11 (נְקֻדָּה) * ;]
a tattoed mark or brand: τὰ σ. τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, Gl 6:17 (see Lft., in l; Deiss., BS, 349; LAE, 303; MM, xxiii).†
(AS)

G4743.def:
στιγμή, -ῆς, ἡ
(στίζω, to prick), [in LXX: Is 29:5 (פֶּתַע), 2Ma.9:11 * ;]
a prick, a point; metaphorically, σ. χρόνου, a moment: Lc 4:5.†
(AS)

G4744.def:
στίλβω
[in LXX: Na 3:3 (לַהַב), etc. ;]
to shine, glisten: Mc 9:3.†
(AS)

G4745.def:
στοά, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX: Eze.40:18 (רִצְפָּה), etc. ;]
a portico: Jo 5:2; used of the covered colonnade in the Temple (EV, porch), Jo 10:23 At 3:11 5:12 †
(AS)

G4746.def:
στοιβάς, see: στιβάς.
στιβάς, -άδος, ἡ,
[in Aq.: Eze.46:23 (טִירוֺת) * ;]
a litter of leaves or rushes: pl., Mc 11:8 (Rec. στοιβ-).†
(AS)

G4747.def:
στοιχεῖον, -ου, τό
[in LXX: Wis.7:17 19:18, 4Ma.12:13 * ;]
prop., one of a row (στοῖχος) or series, hence,
__1. the shadow-line of a dial (Aristoph.).
__2. an elementary sound or letter of the alphabet (Anth., Plut., π.).
__3. the elements or rudiments of knowledge (Arist., al.) Hb 5:12; πτωχὰ σ., Gl 4:9; σ. τοῦ κόσμου, Gl 4:3, Cl 2:8, 20 (but see infr.).
__4. The material elements of the universe (Plat.; LXX, ll. with): 2Pe 3:10 3:12.
__5. The heavenly bodies (Ding. Laert.).
__6. The demons or tutelary spirits of nature (Enoch., Test., Sol., al.; for this sense in Ga, Col, ll. with, see ICC on Cl 2:8; Enc. Bibl., see word " Elements ").†
(AS)

G4748.def:
στοιχέω, -ῶ
(στοῖχος, a row), [in LXX: Ec 11:6 (כָּשֵׁר) * ;]
to be in rows (of waves, plants, etc., as well as of men), to walk in line (esp. of marching in file to battle; Xen., Cyr., vi, 3, 34, al.). Metaphorical, in late writers, to walk by rule: At 21:24; with dative, to walk by or in (as a rule of life), Rm 4:12 (cf. MM, xxiii), Gl 5:25 6:16, Fp 3:16 (cf. συν-στοιχέω).†
(AS)

G4749.def:
στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(στέλλω), [in LXX chiefly for בֶּגֶד, also for לְבוּשׁ, etc. ;]
__1 1, an equipment, an armament (Æsch.).
__2. Equipment in clothes, apparel, esp. flowing raiment, a festal robe: (cf. Jn 3:6, Et 8:15, 1Ma.6:15): Mc 12:38 16:5, Lc 15:22 20:46, Ap 6:11 7:9, 13-14 22:14.†
(AS)

G4750.def:
στόμα, -τος, τό
[in LXX chiefly for פֻּם ;]
the mouth: of man, Mt 15:11, Jo 19:29, At 11:8, al.; of animals, Mt 17:27, 2Tm 4:17 (fig.), Hb 11:33, Tg 3:3, al.; figuratively, of inanimate things (ποταμοῦ, Hom.), ἤνοιξεν ἡ γῆ τὸ σ., Ap 12:16; σ. μαχαίρας (Heb. חֶרֶב ־פֶּה, Gn 34:26 al.), the edge of the sword, Lc 21:24, Hb 11:34; esp. of the mouth as the organ of speech: opposite to καρδία, Mt 12:34, Rm 10:8, 10; in various phrases (some cl., some resembling Hebrew; cf. Bl., § 40, 9): ἀνοίγειν τ. σ. (see: ἀνοίγω); σ. πρὸς σ. (פֶּה ־אֵל פֶּה Nm 12:8; = cl., κατὰ σ., Hdt., al.), face to face, II Jn 12, 3Jn.14; διὰ τοῦ σ. (of the Holy Spirit), Lc 1:70, At 1:16, al.; ἀπὸ (ἐκ) τοῦ σ. (cf. ἀπὸ σ. εἰπεῖν, Plat., al.), of speaking by word of mouth, Lc 22:71, At 22:14; δόλος (ψεῦδος) ἐν τ. σ., 1Pe 2:22, Ap 14:5" (LXX) ; metaphorically, ἡ ῥομφαία τοῦ σ., Ap 2:16. By meton., for speech (Soph.): Mt 18:16 (LXX), Lc 19:22 21:15, 2Co 13:1
(AS)

G4751.def:
στόμαχος, -ου, ὁ
(στόμα),
prop., a mouth, an opening;
__(a) in early Gk. writers, the throat;
__(b) of the opening of the stomach (Arist.);
__(with) in later writers (Plut., al.), the stomach: 1Tm 5:23.†
(AS)

G4752.def:
στρατεία (on the orthogr., see Deiss., BS, 181 f.), -ας, ἡ
(οτρατεύω), [in LXX chiefly for צָבָא ;]
an expedition, a campaign, warfare: metaphorically, 2Co 10:4 (-τιά, T), 1Tm 1:18.†
(AS)

G4753.def:
στράτευμα, -τος, τό
(στρατεύω), [in LXX: 1Ma.9:34, 2Ma.5:24 2Mac 8:21 2Mac 12:38 2Mac 13:13; pl., Jdth.11:8, 4Ma.5:1 * ;]
__1. = στρατεία (Hdt., al.).
__2. an army, a host: pl., Mt 22:7, Ap 9:16 19:14, 19; = soldiers, company of soldiers, At 23:10, 27; pl., Lc 23:11.†
(AS)

G4754.def:
στρατεύω and depon., -ομαι, so always in NT
(στρατός, an encamped army), [in LXX for מההּ hith., יָצָא, צָבָא; metaphorically, 4Ma.9:23 ;]
used of the general, to make war, do battle, and (chiefly) of the soldiers serving under him, to serve as a soldier: Lc 3:14, 1Co 9:7, 2Tm 2:4. Metaphorical (cf. MM, ii, xxiii), of spiritual conflict, to war, make war: 2Co 10:3, 1Tm 1:18, Tg 4:1, 1Pe 2:11.†
(AS)

G4755.def:
στρατηγός, -οῦ, ὁ
(στραός, ἄγω), [in LXX chiefly for סָגָן (always in pl.), שַׂר ;]
__1. a military commander, a general (Hdt., al.).
__2. A civic commander, a governor, magistrate (Hdt., Xen., al.): At 16:20, 22 16:35-36, 38.
__3. The commander of the Levitical guard of the Temple, ὁ σ. τ. ἱεροῦ (EV, captain of the Temple): At 4:1 5:24, 26; pl., Lc 22:4, 52.†
SYN.: ἄρχων (cf. EGT on At 16:20; Ramsay, St. Paul, 217). (AS)

G4756.def:
στρατιά, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for צָבָא ;]
__1. = στρατός, an army, a host: of angels (3Ki.22:19, al.), Lc 2:13; of the stars of heaven (Jr 8:2, 2Cr 33:3), At 7:42.
__2. As sometimes in cl. (poët.), = στρατεία: 2Co 10:4, T (WH, RV, στρατεία).†
(AS)

G4757.def:
στρατιώτης, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX; 2Rs 23:8 B1, 2Ma.5:12 2Mac 14:39, III Mac 3:12; 3Ma.3:4 Mac3 * ;]
a soldier: Mt 8:9, Mc 15:16, Jo 19:2, At 10:7, al.; metaphorically, σ. Χριστοῦ Ἰησ., 2Tm 2:3.†
(AS)

G4758.def:
στρατολογέω, -ῶ
(στρατός, λέγω),
to levy a troop, enlist soldiers: 2Tm 2:4 (Diod., Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G4759.def:
στρατοπέδ-αρχος (Rec. -ης), -ου, ὁ
(στρατόπεδον, ἄρχω), a military commander, esp. the Pretorian prefect: At 28:16 (WH, om.).†
στρατοπεδάρχης, see: στρατοπέδαρχος
(AS)

G4760.def:
στρατό-πεδον, -ου, τό
(στρατός + πέδον, a plain), [in LXX: Jr 34:1 (חַיִל), 2Ma.8:12, al. ;]
__(a) a military camp;
__(b) an army: Lc 21:20.†
(AS)

G4761.def:
στρεβλόω, -ῶ
(στρέφω), [in LXX: 2Rs 22:27 (פָּתַל hithp.), 3Ma.4:14, 4Ma.9:17 4Mac 12:4 4Mac 12:11 4Mac 15:14 * ;]
to twist, torture. Metaphorical (cf. 2Ki, l.with), to twist or pervert language: 2Pe 3:16.†
(AS)

G4762.def:
στρέφω
[in LXX chiefly for הָפַךְ, also for סָבַב, etc. ;]
to turn: with accusative of thing(s) dative of person(s), Mt 5:39; = ἀποσ-, to bring back, Mt 27:3 (cf. Is 38:8); reflexively (WM, § 38, 1), to turn oneself, At 7:42; with accusative before εἰς, = μετασ-, to change, Ap 11:6. Pass., reflexive, to turn oneself: before εἰς, Jo 20:14, At 7:39 13:46; ptcp., στραφείς, with indic., Mt 7:6 9:22 16:23, Lc 7:9 9:55 14:25 22:61, Jo 1:38 20:16; id. before πρός, Lc 7:44 10:22 (WH, R, om.), Lc 7:23 23:28; metaphorically, to change: absol., Mt 18:3, Jo 12:40 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ, ἐπι-, κατα-, μετα-, συ(ν)-, ὑπο-στρέφω).†
(AS)

G4763.def:
στρηνιάω, ῶ
(στρῆνος, which see), [in Sm.: Is 61:6 (אָכַל) * ;]
a word which first appears in the middle comedy (Rutherford, NPhr., 475 f.), to run riot, wax wanton: Ap 18:7-9 (cf. κατα-στρηνιάω).†
SYN.: σπαταλάω (which see), τρυφάω (AS)

G4764.def:
στρῆνος, -ους, τό
(cf. Lat. strenuus), [in LXX: 4Ki.19:28 (שַׁאֲנָן)* ;]
insolent luxury, wantonness: Ap 18:3 (a late word, first found in a Comic poet, B.C. 300, see Kennedy, Sources, 41, cf. στρηνιάω).†
(AS)

G4765.def:
στρουθίον, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for צִפּוֹר ;]
dimin. of στρουθός
a sparrow: Mt 10:29, 31, Lc 12:6-7.†
(AS)

G4766.def:
στρωννύω or στρώννυμι
(seeBl., § 23, 1; Veitch, see word), [in LXX for יַצַע hoph., etc. ;]
to spread: ἱμάτια ἐν τ. ὁδῷ (εἰς τ. ὁδόν), Mt 21:8, Mc 11:8; of making a bed, στρῶσον (sc. τ. κλίνην) σεαυτῷ, At 9:34; of furnishing a room, ἐστρωμένον, spread with carpets or carpeted couches (cf. Eze.23:41), Mc 14:15, Lc 22:12.†
(AS)

G4768.def:
στυγνάζω
(στυγνός, sombre, gloomy, sullen, Is 5:17, Wis.17:5, Dan LXX 2:12*), [in LXX: Eze.27:35 28:19 32:10 (שָׁמֵם)* ;]
to have a sombre, gloomy appearance: of the human countenance (RV, his countenance fell), Mc 10:22; of the sky (so στυγνότης, Polyb., iv, 21, 1), Mt 16:3 ([WH], R, mg., om.).†
(AS)

G4769.def:
στύλος (T, στῦλος, as in cl.), -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for עַמּוּד, also for קֶרֶשׁ, etc. ;]
a pillar, regarded especially as a support: σ. πυρός, Ap 10:1; σ. ἐν τ. ναῷ, figuratively, Ap 3:12, Metaphorical, Gl 2:9; τ. ἀληθείας, 1Tm 3:15.†
(AS)

G4771.def:
σύ,
pron. of 2nd of person(s),
thou, you, genitive, σοῦ, dative, σοί, accusative, σέ, pl., ὑμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς (enclitic in oblique cases sing., except after prep. (BL, §48, 3), though πρὸς σέ occurs in Mt 25:39). Nom. for emphasis or contrast: Jo 1:30, 4:10, 5:33, 39, 44, At 4:7, Ef 5:32; so also perhaps σὺ εἶπας, Mt 26:64, al. (M, Pr., 86); before voc., Mt 2:6, Lc 1:76, Jo 17:5, al.; sometimes without emphasis (M, Pr., 85f.), as also in cl., but esp. as rendering of Heb. phrase, e.g. υἱός μου εἶ σύ (בְּנִי־אַתָּה, Sl 2:7), At 13:33. The genitive (σοῦ, ὑμῶν) is sometimes placed bef. the noun: Lc 7:48, 12:30, al.; so also the enclitic σοῦ, Mt 9:6; on τί ἐμοὶ κ. σοί, see: ἐγώ.
(AS)

G4772.def:
συγγένεια, -ας, ἡ
(συγγενής), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּחָה ;]
__1. kinship.
__2. By meton., kinsfolk, kindred: Lc 1:61, At 7:3, 14 †
(AS)

G4773.def:
σνγγενής, -ές (dative pl., -εῦσιν, Mc 6:4, Lc 2:44, as though from -εύς, see Swete, Mk., l.with; Bl., § 8, 6; cf. 1Ma.10:89 A א2 *;)
(σύν, γένος), [in LXX for דּוֹד, דּוֹדָה, מִשְׁפָּחָה ;]
__1. congenital, natural, innate.
__2. akin to; as subst., a kinsman: Mc 6:4, Lc 1:58 2:44 14:12 21:16, Jo 18:26, At 10:24; of tribal kinship, Rm 9:3 16:7, 11 16:21.†
SYN.: ἴδιος, οἰκεῖος (which see) (AS)

G4774.def:
συν-γνώμη (Rec. συγγ-), -ης, ἡ
(συγγιγνώσκω, (a) to agree with; (b) to pardon), [in LXX: Sir prol.14 (B1N1 cm.) 313, 2Mac 14:20* ;]
__1. confession.
__2. fellow feeling; hence, concession, allowance: 1Co 7:6 (see ICC, in l).
__3. pardon.†
(AS)

G4775.def:
συν-κάθημαι
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Sl 101:6 (יָשַׁב) * ;]
to sit together or with: with dative, At 26:30; before μετά, with genitive, Mc 14:54.†
(AS)

G4776.def:
περι-καθ-ίζω
[in LXX for חָנָה, לָחַם ni., etc. ;]
__1. to invest, besiege (Diod., 4Ki.6:24, 1Ma.11:61, al.).
__2. to sit around: Lc 22:55, L, txt.
† (AS)

G4777.def:
συν-κακοπαθέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ,
to bear evil treatment along with, take one's share of ill-treatment: 2Tm 2:3; with dative commod., τ. εὐαγγελίῳ, 2Tm 2:18.†
(AS)

G4778.def:
συν-κακουχέομαι (Rec. συγκ-), -οῦμαι, pass.
to endure adversity with: with dative of person(s), Hb 11:25. Not elsewhere.†
(AS)

G4779.def:
συν-καλέω
(Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, [in LXX for קָרָא ;]
to call together: with accusative, Mc 15:16, Lc 15:6, 9 (seel. -εῖται, see B1., § 55, 1), At 5:21. Mid., to call together to oneself: Lc 9:1 (and seel. in Lc 15:6, 9 see supr.) Lc 23:13, At 10:24 28:17.†
(AS)

G4780.def:
συν-καλύπτω
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX chiefly for כָּסָה pi. ;]
to veil or cover completely: with accusative, pass., Lc 12:2.†
(AS)

G4781.def:
συν-κάμπτω
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Sl 68:10, 23 (מעד hi.), etc. ;]
to bend completely, bend together: τ. νῶτον, figuratively, Rm 11:10 (LXX).†
(AS)

G4782.def:
συν-κατα-βαίνω
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Sl 49:17 (יָרַד), Wis.10:13, Dan LXX TH 3:49 * ;]
to go down with: At 25:5. In late writers also metaphorically (Wis, l.with), to condescend, on WH. see Rutherford, NPhr., 485 f.†
(AS)

G4784.def:
συν-κατα-τίθημι
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Êx 23:1 (שִׁית יָד), Êx 23:32 (בְּרִית), Da TH Su 1:20 * ;]
to deposit together. Mid., to deposit one's vote with, hence, to agree with, assent to: with dative, Lc 23:51.†
(AS)

G4785.def:
συν-κατα-ψηφίζω (Rec. συγκ-),
__1. to condemn with or together (Plut., Themist., 21).
__2. to vote one a place among: pass., At 1:26. Not elsewhere .†
(AS)

G4786.def:
συν-κεράννυμι
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:43 (עֲרַב ithpa.), 2Ma.15:39 * ;]
to mix or blend together, compound: with accusative, 1Co 12:24; ptcp. pf. pass., Hb 4:2, T, WH, mg., R, mg.; id., of persons, with dative instr., to be united with, agree with, ib., WH, txt., R, txt. (see Westc., in l).†
(AS)

G4787.def:
συν-κινέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ,
to move together. Metaphorical, to excite, stir up: τ. λαόν, At 6:12 (Arist., Polyb., al.).†
(AS)

G4788.def:
συν-κλείω
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX chiefly for סגר ;]
to shut together, enclose, shut in on all sides: of a catch of fish, Lc 5:6; metaphorically (Sl 31:9, al.), Rm 11:32, Gl 3:22-23.†
(AS)

G4789.def:
συν-κληρο-νόμος (Rec. συγκ-), -ου, ὁ
a co-inheritor, fellow-heir: Rm 8:17, Ef 3:6; with genitive of thing(s), Hb 11:9, 1Pe 3:7 (for exx., see Deiss., LAE, 88 f.).†
(AS)

G4790.def:
συν-κοινωνέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ,
to have fellowship with or in (in cl., with genitive of thing(s), dative of person(s)): with dative of thing(s), Ef 5:11, Ap 18:4; id. with genitive of person(s), Fp 4:14.†
(AS)

G4791.def:
συν-κοινωνός (Rec. συγκ-), όν,
partaking jointly of: with genitive of thing(s), Rm 11:17, 1Co 9:23; id. with genitive of person(s), Fp 1:7; before ἐν, Ap 1:9.†
(AS)

G4792.def:
συν-κομίζω
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Jó 5:26 (עָלָה) * ;]
__1. to bring together, collect (Hdt., Xen., al.).
__2. to take up a body for burial (Soph., Aj., 1048): At 8:2 (see Field, Notes, 116).†
(AS)

G4793.def:
συν-κρίνω (Rec. συγκ-)
[in LXX chiefly for פָּתַר ;]
__1. to compound, combine: 1Co 2:13, R, mg.1 (Lft., Notes, 180 f.).
__2. In Arist. and later writers (Wis.7:29, a1.) = παραβάλλω, to compare: 1Co, l.with, R, txt. (Field, Notes, 168), 2Co 10:12
__3. In LXX, of dreams, to interpret (Gn 40:8, 1Co, l.with, R, mg. 2 (but see reff. supr.).†
(AS)

G4794.def:
συν-κύπτω
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Jó 9:27 (עָזַב), Sir.12:11 19:26 * ;]
__1. to bend forwards (Arist., al.).
__2. to be bowed down: Lc 13:11.†
(AS)

G4795.def:
συγκυρία, -ας, ἡ
(συγκυρέω, to happen), [in Sm.: 1Rs 6:9 (מִקְרֶה) * ;] (more frequently in late writers, συγκύρησις, -ημα),
chance, coincidence: κατὰ σ. (see MM, xxiii), Lc 10:31 (Hippocr., Eccl.).†
(AS)

G4796.def:
συν-χαίρω
(Rec. συγ-), [in LXX: Gn 21:6 (צָחַק), 3Ma.1:8 R * ;]
__1. to rejoice with: with dative of person(s), Lc 1:58 15:6, 9, Fp 2:17-18, EV; with dative of thing(s), 1Co 12:26 13:6.
__2. to congratulate (Æschin., Polyb., al.): Phi, l.with (Lft., in I.; cf. MM, xxiv).†
(AS)

G4797.def:
συν-χέω
(Rec. συγ-), [in LXX for בָּלַל, רָגַז, etc. ;]
to pour together, commingle, confuse; metaphorically, confound, throw into confusion, stir up trouble: At 21:27 (cf. συν-χύννω).†
(AS)

G4798.def:
συν-χράομαι
(Rec. συγ-), -ῶμαι, [in Al.: 1Rs 30:19 * ;]
to use together with. Metaphorical, with dative of person(s), to associate with: Jo 4:9 (Polyb., a1.).†
(AS)

G4799.def:
σύγχυσις, -εως, ἡ
(συγχέω), [in LXX: Gn 11:9 (בָּבֶל), 1Rs 5:6 5:12(11) 1Rs 14:20 (מְהוּמָה) * ;]
confusion: of a popular uproar, At 19:29.†
(AS)
